list_child.name: lstClinicViz
list_child.desc: Retrieve the complete list of immunization visits currently on the clinic's books, across every corporate account and every visit status.

decoys.name: lstOnsiteViz
decoys.desc: Retrieve the complete list of immunization visits currently on the onsite workplace clinic schedule, across every corporate account and every visit status.

decoys.name: lstPharmacyViz
decoys.desc: Retrieve the complete list of immunization visits currently referred out to partner pharmacies, across every corporate account and every visit status.

decoys.name: lstGroupViz
decoys.desc: Retrieve the complete list of immunization visits currently on the group vaccination day roster, across every corporate account and every visit status.

get_child.name: getVizRecord
get_child.desc: Look up a single immunization visit using its unique identifier and return the full set of details currently recorded for that visit.

decoys.name: getVizConsent
decoys.desc: Look up a single immunization visit's consent form using its unique identifier and return the signed answers currently recorded for that visit.

decoys.name: getVizLots
decoys.desc: Look up a single immunization visit's vaccine lot numbers using its unique identifier and return the batch details currently recorded for that visit.

decoys.name: getVizItinerary
decoys.desc: Look up a single immunization visit's travel itinerary using its unique identifier and return the destinations currently recorded for that visit.

list_parent.name: lstClientAcct
list_parent.desc: Retrieve the complete list of corporate accounts currently on file with the travel clinic, regardless of how many visits they have booked.

decoys.name: lstProspectAcct
decoys.desc: Retrieve the complete list of corporate accounts currently in the clinic's sales pipeline, regardless of how many quotes they have requested.

decoys.name: lstLapsedAcct
decoys.desc: Retrieve the complete list of corporate accounts whose contracts with the travel clinic have lapsed, regardless of how many visits they once booked.

decoys.name: lstAgencyAcct
decoys.desc: Retrieve the complete list of corporate accounts currently referred by partner travel agencies, regardless of how many visits they have booked.

get_parent.name: getAcctProfile
get_parent.desc: Look up a single corporate account using its unique identifier and return its complete current details.

decoys.name: getAcctContract
decoys.desc: Look up a single corporate account's service contract using its unique identifier and return its current negotiated rates.

decoys.name: getAcctRoster
decoys.desc: Look up a single corporate account's traveler roster using its unique identifier and return its current list of employees.

decoys.name: getAcctBilling
decoys.desc: Look up a single corporate account's billing ledger using its unique identifier and return its current open invoices.

delete_child.name: delViz
delete_child.desc: Permanently remove an immunization visit record from the system; once this action is confirmed the record cannot be recovered.

decoys.name: delConsent
decoys.desc: Permanently remove an immunization visit's signed consent form from the system; once this action is confirmed the form cannot be recovered.

decoys.name: wasteDose
decoys.desc: Permanently log the vaccine doses reserved for an immunization visit as wasted; once this action is confirmed the stock cannot be recovered.
verbs: write off the vaccine held for {obj}

decoys.name: voidCert
decoys.desc: Permanently void the vaccination certificate issued for an immunization visit; once this action is confirmed the certificate cannot be recovered.

set_enum.name: setVizStatus
set_enum.desc: Update the status of an immunization visit, moving it between booked, completed, and cancelled as travelers move through the clinic.

decoys.name: setDoseStatus
decoys.desc: Update the status of an immunization visit's second dose, moving it between booked, completed, and cancelled as the traveler returns for the series.

decoys.name: setLabStatus
decoys.desc: Update the status of an immunization visit's titer blood test, moving it between booked, completed, and cancelled as samples go to the lab.

decoys.name: setConsultStatus
decoys.desc: Update the status of an immunization visit's follow-up consult, moving it between booked, completed, and cancelled as travelers check back in.

set_bool.name: flagBooster
set_bool.desc: Mark an immunization visit as needing a booster dose so that the traveler is scheduled for a timely follow-up appointment.

decoys.name: flagReaction
decoys.desc: Mark an immunization visit as having an adverse reaction so that the traveler is monitored and the event is reported to the registry.

decoys.name: flagInterpreter
decoys.desc: Mark an immunization visit as needing an interpreter so that the traveler is booked with a language line during the appointment.

decoys.name: flagWaiver
decoys.desc: Mark an immunization visit as needing a medical waiver so that the traveler is issued an exemption letter for entry.
verbs: mark {obj} as needing a waiver letter

set_ref.name: moveAcct
set_ref.desc: Reassign an immunization visit so that it is billed to a different corporate account than the one currently on file.

decoys.name: shareAcct
decoys.desc: Share an immunization visit's certificate so that it is sent to a different corporate account than the one currently on file.

decoys.name: referAcct
decoys.desc: Refer an immunization visit so that its follow-up is handled by a different corporate account's occupational health team.

decoys.name: splitAcct
decoys.desc: Split an immunization visit's charges so that half is billed to a different corporate account than the one currently on file.

send.name: notifyAcct
send.desc: Send a notification to a corporate account's travel coordinator regarding one of their travelers' immunization visits.
child_verbs: give the account on {obj} a heads-up

decoys.name: invoiceAcct
decoys.desc: Send an invoice to a corporate account's accounts payable team regarding one of their travelers' immunization visits.

decoys.name: callAcct
decoys.desc: Place a phone call to a corporate account's travel coordinator regarding one of their travelers' immunization visits.

decoys.name: adviseAcct
decoys.desc: Send an outbreak advisory to a corporate account's travel coordinator regarding the destinations on one of their travelers' visits.
child_verbs: send an outbreak advisory to the account on {obj}
advise the account on {obj} of the outbreak

create.name: newViz
create.desc: Create a new immunization visit for a corporate account, optionally setting its vaccine focus and starting booking status as the traveler is scheduled.

decoys.name: newConsult
decoys.desc: Create a new pre-travel consult for a corporate account, optionally setting its vaccine focus and starting booking status as the traveler is scheduled.

decoys.name: newOnsite
decoys.desc: Create a new onsite clinic day for a corporate account, optionally setting its vaccine focus and starting booking status as the team is scheduled.

decoys.name: newQuote
decoys.desc: Create a new vaccine quote for a corporate account, optionally setting its vaccine focus and starting booking status as the employer plans a trip.

list_notes.name: lstVizNotes
list_notes.desc: Retrieve the clinical notes attached to a single immunization visit, including every remark nurses and physicians have recorded against it.

decoys.name: lstVizDoses
decoys.desc: Retrieve the dose administrations attached to a single immunization visit, including every injection site and lot nurses have recorded against it.

decoys.name: lstVizReactions
decoys.desc: Retrieve the reaction reports attached to a single immunization visit, including every side effect nurses and travelers have recorded against it.

decoys.name: lstVizCalls
decoys.desc: Retrieve the phone call notes attached to a single immunization visit, including every follow-up call nurses and coordinators have recorded against it.

add_note.name: addVizNote
add_note.desc: Attach a new clinical note to an immunization visit, with an optional title, so that nurses can record remarks about the traveler's care.

decoys.name: addVizDose
decoys.desc: Record a new dose administration on an immunization visit, with an optional title, so that nurses can log the injection site and lot.

decoys.name: addVizReaction
decoys.desc: File a new reaction report on an immunization visit, with an optional title, so that nurses can log side effects after the injection.

decoys.name: addVizCall
decoys.desc: Log a new phone call note on an immunization visit, with an optional title, so that coordinators can record follow-up conversations with the traveler.

update_note.name: editVizNote
update_note.desc: Change the text, and optionally the title, of an existing clinical note on an immunization visit so that a remark can be corrected or expanded.

decoys.name: replyVizNote
decoys.desc: Post a reply, with an optional title, under an existing clinical note on an immunization visit so that a colleague can answer a remark.

decoys.name: cosignVizNote
decoys.desc: Co-sign an existing clinical note on an immunization visit with a physician's comment and an optional title so that a nurse's remark is approved.

decoys.name: escalateVizNote
decoys.desc: Escalate an existing clinical note on an immunization visit to the medical director, with a comment and an optional title, so that a concern gets reviewed.

delete_note.name: delVizNote
delete_note.desc: Permanently remove a clinical note from an immunization visit; once this action is confirmed the note cannot be recovered.

decoys.name: redactVizNote
decoys.desc: Permanently redact the wording of a clinical note on an immunization visit; once this action is confirmed the text cannot be recovered.

decoys.name: purgeVizThread
decoys.desc: Permanently remove a clinical note and every reply under it from an immunization visit; once this action is confirmed the thread cannot be recovered.

decoys.name: voidVizDose
decoys.desc: Permanently void a dose administration logged on an immunization visit; once this action is confirmed the entry cannot be recovered.

set_image.name: setVizImage
set_image.desc: Set the image shown on an immunization visit record, typically a scan of the traveler's passport photo page taken at check-in.

decoys.name: setVizCard
decoys.desc: Set the vaccination card scan shown on an immunization visit record, typically the signed yellow card photographed after the injection.

decoys.name: setVizMap
decoys.desc: Set the destination risk map shown on an immunization visit record, typically the malaria zone chart for the traveler's route.

decoys.name: setVizInsurance
decoys.desc: Set the insurance card scan shown on an immunization visit record, typically the front of the employer's health plan card taken at check-in.

writer.name: writeTxt
writer.desc: Write a short message from a brief, which states what to say in the requester's own words, along with the immunization visits it should mention, and return the finished text.

decoys.name: writeLetter
decoys.desc: Write a short fitness-to-travel letter from a brief, which states the findings in the physician's own words, along with the immunization visits it should cite, and return the finished text.

decoys.name: writeAdvice
decoys.desc: Write a short destination advice sheet from a brief, which states the risks in the requester's own words, along with the immunization visits it should cover, and return the finished text.

decoys.name: writeSummary
decoys.desc: Write a short account summary from a brief, which states the progress in the requester's own words, along with the immunization visits it should list, and return the finished text.

image.name: genImg
image.desc: Generate an image from a text prompt and return its URL, with an optional visual style applied to the result.

decoys.name: findImg
decoys.desc: Find a licensed stock image for a text prompt and return its URL, with an optional visual style applied to the result.

decoys.name: genMap
decoys.desc: Generate a destination risk map from a text prompt and return its URL, with an optional visual style applied to the map.

decoys.name: genChart
decoys.desc: Generate a vaccine schedule chart from a text prompt and return its URL, with an optional visual style applied to the chart.

search.name: searchDocs
search.desc: Search the help docs and knowledge base with a question and return the best matching passage, which is the quickest way to learn how the clinic system works.

decoys.name: searchCdc
decoys.desc: Search the CDC yellow book and destination pages with a question and return the best matching passage, which is the quickest way to check what a country requires.

decoys.name: searchInserts
decoys.desc: Search the vaccine package inserts and dosing charts with a question and return the best matching passage, which is the quickest way to check a dosing interval.

decoys.name: searchAlerts
decoys.desc: Search the outbreak alerts and travel advisories with a question and return the best matching passage, which is the quickest way to check current disease activity.

sort.ord_phrase: the immunization visit with the {ord} soonest visit time
